sortByShootingTimeInfo.title: Sort By Shooting Time
sortByShootingTimeInfo.intro: When "By Shooting Time" is selected, in order to sort files, this application
sortByShootingTimeInfo.step1: tries to use DateTimeOriginal in EXIF, and if it is not available,
sortByShootingTimeInfo.step2: uses the modified time of the file.
sortByShootingTimeInfo.foldersNote: Note that folders are sorted by their names since there is no concept of "Shooting Time" of folders.

details.mostTrustworthy: DateTimeOriginal in EXIF is the most trustworthy information about the time when the photo was taken.
details.sometimesMissing: DateTimeOriginal is written in most JPEG/HEIF/TIFF files by most cameras, but sometimes it is missing.
details.modifiedTime: The modified time of the file is often the time when the photo was taken, so the modified time is used as an alternative when DateTimeOriginal is missing.
details.otherFiles: Also, files other than JPEG/HEIF/TIFF do not have EXIF in the first place, so the modified time is always used for such files.

photoInfo.pathTooLong: Thumbnail cannot be displayed because the length of the file path is {{length}}. Windows restricts the maximum path length to {{maximum}}. Please change file location to shorten the path of the file. For details, press Ctrl+Shift+I and read the console messages.
photoInfo.generatedThumbnailPathTooLong: Thumbnail cannot be displayed because the length of the file path of the generated thumbnail is {{length}}. Windows restricts the maximum path length to {{maximum}}. Please change file location to shorten the path of the generated thumbnail. For details, press Ctrl+Shift+I and read the console messages.
